scope: The consumer pre-push hook respects .gitignore so it scans only what CI scans (ADR-0082, #134): collects git's ignore set and appends --ignore <path> to each gate whose invoke already uses --ignore. No path-waiver (mdenner's call); manifest untouched; gate scripts untouched.

boundary.evidence: ignore-matching lives in the local pre-flight whose job is to mirror CI; reuses each gate's public --ignore CLI contract (ADR-0059), no gate-internal reach-in

ownership.evidence: 'what git ignores' is owned by git and read live (no hardcoded name list); gate-manifest.json unchanged (git diff main -- gate-manifest.json EMPTY), still the single source of each gate's scan args

dependency.evidence: depends only on git (already used for rev-parse) + the gates' public CLI; append gated on the gate's own declared --ignore capability; 7 gates accept it, 4 don't broad-scan and are untouched

error-handling.evidence: the one catch recovers by scanning everything (documented fail-safe toward scanning MORE, not less); fixed git command, no shell, no injection
